description: Lore documentation factory — deterministic enforcement of BLOCKING DoD rules. check-image-path.sh blocks (exit 2) any docs/ markdown using /static/img/ or any image written under docs/ (§6/Rule 1). check-frontmatter.sh blocks (exit 2) any docs/ markdown missing valid frontmatter keys (§2/§6). verify-docs.sh warns (non-blocking) about orphan images on Stop. Scope carve-out: .claude/**, templates/**, and _templates/** intentional examples are ignored.
